programs.name: Jupiter Aggregator v6 (Swap)
programs.upgradeAuthorityKind: plain wallet (single key, NOT a multisig) - confirmed in solgov-api.ts ADDRESS_TO_PROTOCOL as 'Jupiter v6 (upgrade auth)'
programs.notes: Jupiter v6 upgrade authority is a SINGLE KEY, not multisig-controlled. This is an intentional design choice by Jupiter (acknowledged publicly). Different risk profile from their Perps/Lend products.

multisigs.role: Jupiter Agg governance multisig (Squads V3, tracked)
multisigs.notes: V3 multisig - different risk surface from V4. No timelocks available in V3. May not be the program upgrade authority - that is CvQZZ23q (plain wallet).

authorities.role: Jupiter v6 swap program upgrade authority
authorities.notes: Not a multisig. Single-signer upgrade authority on a program routing ~50% of Solana DEX volume. Material governance risk and a public fact - Jupiter has discussed plans to move this to a multisig.

governanceModel: Split: the v6 swap program (JUP6LkbZ) has a plain-wallet upgrade authority (CvQZZ23q). The governance multisig (7ZyDFzet6s, Squads V3 4/8) is separate and handles other operational authorities, but is NOT the program upgrade authority.
gaps: Enumerate what the Squads V3 multisig 7ZyDFzet6s actually controls (if anything distinct from program upgrade auth)
